(WebSearch snippet + WebFetch extract of Kyiv Independent, Aug 8 2026. Cross-ref: Al Jazeera Russia-Ukraine live coverage.)

Russian attacks across Ukraine kill at least 12, injure 81 - Aug 8 2026.

- Russian attacks across Ukraine killed at least 12 people and injured ~81-82 over the past day (Aug 8), as an overnight strike again pounded Kyiv and Kyiv Oblast.
- Overnight: Russia launched six Iskander-M ballistic missiles plus S-400 surface-to-air missiles; "No missiles were shot down," as Ukraine faces a critical shortage of Patriot interceptors (per the Air Force).
- The Air Force said 151 drones were used in the attack; 135 drones were shot down or neutralised via electronic warfare.
- Zelensky said the three people killed in Kyiv Oblast's Brovary district on Aug 8 were "a grandmother, grandfather, and their three-year-old grandson."
- During the day Aug 7, Russia continued assaulting Ukraine's energy infrastructure, hitting four Ukrnafta gas stations in Zaporizhzhia and Dnipropetrovsk oblasts.
- (Advances this morning's brief, which had reported one child killed near Kyiv; evening toll is at least 12 dead / ~81 injured nationally with the family-of-three detail confirmed.)
